page.overview:
What is Throh?

Throh is a humanoid Pokémon dressed in a gi, a traditional training and contest uniform among many martial arts. His head is red and has very large eyebrows. He is shorter than Sawk, and has 3 toes that make a triangle shape.

Throh is a Fighting-type Pokémon with a bulky body, red, rocky skin, and seemingly wearing a white and black martial arts outfit. His head is round, with a “Y”-shaped black feature over his eyes and nose. The collar of his outfit is rimmed in black, and the sleeves sport a crisscrossed pattern. Throh's hands are red with three bulbous, gecko-like fingers. He has a black, martial-arts style belt, and his white “pants” have black patches on the knees. His feet have three digits. His power increases when his belt is tied. Wild ones can create their own belts. Throh have a tendency to throw around larger opponents. They live in herds of around five Pokémon. He creates his own belt by weaving vines.

This Pokémon learns no moves by Breeding.
